title: PS26011 3D Building Map
subtitle: AERO-VIEW · 3D ULPIN & Vertical Property Mapper
description: An interactive 3D cadastral viewer for Siripuram, Visakhapatnam. Explore buildings as parcel-to-unit stacks, inspect underground utility corridors, and see provenance for real, estimated, and synthetic demo data.
imageAlt: 3D ULPIN map interface showing Siripuram, Visakhapatnam

title: Ushodhya Lassi Corner
subtitle: Food · Brand · Website
description: Brand site for a local lassi shop — menu, story and ordering info with a warm, playful identity. Smooth page transitions and a mobile-first layout built for quick loads on any phone.
imageAlt: Mango lassi drink for the Ushodhya Lassi Corner project

title: Cinematic Travel Edit
subtitle: Short Film · Editing
description: A cinematic travel short cut from raw drone and handheld footage — colour graded, sound designed and paced for a story that hits different.

title: Short Form Content
subtitle: Reels · Shorts · Edits
description: Ongoing series of short-form edits for social — hooks, captions and pacing tuned for reels, shorts and stories.

title: Glance for Windows
subtitle: On-device face unlock for Windows 11
description: A native Windows desktop app that adds a glance-based face-unlock flow using a standard webcam. Face processing runs locally with ONNX Runtime and InsightFace; it is designed as a convenience feature, not a replacement for Windows Hello security.
imageAlt: Glance for Windows download graphic with a face-unlock icon

title: DevSocio
subtitle: A social platform concept for developers
description: A developer-first community platform concept for sharing projects, meeting collaborators, and discovering opportunities. The repository describes an early-stage product with planned social, real-time, and AI-assisted features.

title: ResumePulse
subtitle: ATS-friendly resume builder
description: A responsive resume builder with a guided multi-step form, live preview, and ATS-friendly formatting. The project pairs a lightweight HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend with a Node.js and Express backend.

title: AgriShield AI
subtitle: Rice disease intelligence for farmers
description: An agricultural support platform focused on rice farming, combining leaf-disease detection with treatment guidance, weather insights, multilingual assistance, and a farmer community. The repository pairs a Next.js frontend with a FastAPI and TensorFlow backend.

title: Swiggy LifeOS
subtitle: AI lifestyle assistant built around Swiggy MCP
description: A concept lifestyle operating system that brings meal planning, grocery restocking, dining, and daily routines into one conversational agent. The web experience demonstrates cross-service workflows using Swiggy MCP.
